simulator.note: Boots as a 256 MB M3503 revision B chip (chips/m3503.py: uppercase BOOTLOADER / SEECODE chunk names, numeric-named 0x01FE0101 maincode chunk "114003202102162", variant 0x0001 so sys_ic_get_rev_id() returns 0x20002 and keeps GMA layer 0 enabled): runs XIP with its stack in cache-as-RAM, unpacks SEECODE (2.8 MB) to 0xAE000200 after setting 0xB8000220 bit 24 to remap physical 0x0F000000..0x0FFFFFFF to DDR, unpacks the 7.8 MB main code to 0x80000200, starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE EBase 0x8E002001), verifies the application over SHA-256 on CryptoEngine, powers both USB ports (GPIO 72 left, GPIO 70 right; active-low overcurrent fault inputs GPIO 67 and 71 pulled up via device.gpioPullUps, without which the panel shows "USbP"), and draws its Polish first-install wizard "1 Wybierz język" (panel "LOC1") by ~70 M instructions (255 GE commands); remote DOWN and front-panel KI3/DIG4 navigate the language list (run_dump_xs65_combo_capture_screen.py).

desc: The 1.4.0 Polish retail update (140_M3515-COMBO-RETAIL-PL.abs, 2016-04-13) for the Opticum XS65 Combo DVB-S2 + DVB-T2/C HD receiver on the 256 MB ALi M3515 SoC with 8 MB SPI flash.

Unlike the 4 MB 128 MB single-tuner Blue XS65 / Globo HD-XS2 build (140_M3511-RETAIL_PL.abs), the 8 MB combo image uses uppercase chunk names (BOOTLOADER, SEECODE), carries a secondary loader pair (SECLOADER + SECSEECODE) ahead of maincode at 0x220000, places its SEE core at 0xAE000200 in 256 MB DDR3, and monitors two USB port power switches (outputs GPIO 72 / 70, active-low fault inputs GPIO 67 / 71).
